basis: Outer wall faces measured via gray-ink pixel profiles (west x=424,east x=1817,north y=346,south y=1086) calibrated to overall 15000x8000mm dimension lines. Interior walls represented as single centerline strokes at measured ink rows (corridor walls y=618 and y=815 pixels). North/south zones are open-plan (no full-height partition found between desk bays: pixel profile at the exterior wall row showed only a weak partial nib at x~883-920, not a continuous wall), so each is modeled as one open room reached via two doors from the corridor plus a south exterior entrance door and a west exterior corridor door found as gaps in the gray wall ink.

assumptions: Wall representative plane: single centerline stroke at measured ink row for each wall, not separate inner/outer faces.
Window sill/head heights assumed 0.9-2.1m and door heights assumed 0-2.1m pending elevation confirmation.
North/south exterior window spans taken from the drawing's own dimension-chain numbers (1240/2400/1300 repeating pattern), not independently pixel-measured for every jamb.
Ceiling height assumed 3.0m, not labelled in plan.
unresolved: Exact jamb pixel positions for exterior windows were derived from the printed dimension chain rather than individually profiled; minor (<0.3m) span error possible.
Door swing/open state not verified beyond symbol presence.
